name: SAVANT Benchmark
description: A benchmark built not to flatter the architecture but to break it: twelve adversarial scenario classes attacking every load-bearing mechanism, nine metrics with formal estimators, a five-arm ablation ladder, a verdict rule that reports a profile and never a scalar, and a reproducibility constitution. Author: Dr. Christabel Odeta — SAVANT / CLAI-OS / AEGIS-GLOBAL. Version 1.0, October 2026. All properties are stated as proof obligations with explicit falsification conditions (C0 informational; confers no clinical, legal, financial, or safety authority).
